goal.definition_of_done: The AxisSlider expected marker is a lucide Bone icon at the predicted spot that does NOT show until the user has set a value on that slider, then fades in (opacity-only, reduced-motion instant) and stays; the intro copy reframes to "set yours first, then I'll show where I'd land". Ruphus's reaction is a chat thread: the coaching bubble is shown, and the moment the user commits an answer a separate loading bubble appears IMMEDIATELY below it (loader visibility NOT gated on the call debounce), then when the reaction resolves it replaces the loader and the coaching bubble fades out; it reacts to the current step's named input, is pro-gated, and the deterministic core works with AI off (no thread/loader when nothing is loading). The loader is a frosted-glass pill (static -webkit-backdrop-filter + inset rim sheen, never animated, never mix-blend) containing a canvas dot-matrix scanning shimmer (DPR-capped, offscreen-paused, reduced-motion single static frame, role=status); no SVG goo/feDisplacement filter ships. An exited in-progress tasting can be resumed: the draft (answers, step index, phase) survives the wizard closing and persists in- session in memory (NO Firebase, NO new persisted field); tapping ✕ with real progress shows a confirm, and the guided-tasting entry offers Resume when a draft exists; manual entry still works. All new motion is transform/opacity/canvas-only, reduced-motion-gated, WKWebView-safe, one-accent, design-bank clean. `npx vite build` exits 0; the wizard harness proves bone-hidden-until-touched + reveal, the chat-thread + immediate loader, the canvas loader present, and resume restoring the draft; verify-tasting/inventory/archive/morph/chat still pass; audit + codex are clean; real fresh device screenshots exist for every changed element (bone hidden, bone revealed, dot-matrix loader, chat-thread, resume prompt); and Tal signs off on device.
goal.statement: Second round of tasting-wizard craft polish (no data/logic change): (1) the slider's expected marker becomes a crisp dog-BONE glyph that is HIDDEN until the user sets their own value, then fades in — so they guess unbiased then compare (true predict-then-confirm); (2) Professor Ruphus's AI reaction reads as a CHAT THREAD — his coaching line in one bubble, and the instant the user answers a loading bubble pops below it IMMEDIATELY (no perceived lag), then the reaction replaces the loader and the coaching bubble fades out; (3) the loader is "alien hardware" — a compact frosted-glass pill with a CANVAS DOT-MATRIX scanning shimmer (the real liquid-glass+dots look), replacing the CSS breathing dots; (4) quitting a tasting no longer loses progress — the draft persists IN-SESSION so the user can RESUME, plus a confirm-on-✕ so an accidental close doesn't discard. WKWebView-safe (canvas rAF + static glass; no goo/feDisplacement filter, no animated backdrop-filter, no mix-blend sheen), transform/opacity/canvas-only, reduced-motion gated, design-bank clean, one accent, verified on-device before done. Dev channel only.
